McInnes' Rangers earn first league win as VAR denies Aberdeen equaliser
items.description: Lawrence Shankland's penalty proved decisive as Rangers secured a 1-0 win at Aberdeen, their first Scottish Premiership win of the season, after the home side were denied a late equaliser by VAR at Pittodrie, easing the pressure on Derek McInnes.
